description: This file defines the SearchInterface, a PHP interface for search plugins in Drupal, specifying methods for setting search parameters, executing searches, and rendering results.

classes.name: SearchInterface
classes.description: Defines a common interface for all SearchPlugin objects in Drupal, including methods for configuring, executing, and rendering search results.

methods.name: setSearch
methods.description: Sets the keywords, parameters, and attributes for the search plugin.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Returns the current attributes from the request.

methods.name: isSearchExecutable
methods.description: Checks if the current search settings are valid and sufficient to perform a search.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the search index type used by the plugin.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the search and returns results.

methods.name: buildResults
methods.description: Builds render arrays for search results.

methods.name: suggestedTitle
methods.description: Provides a suggested title for the search results page.

methods.name: getHelp
methods.description: Returns help information for the search plugin.

methods.name: searchFormAlter
methods.description: Alters the search form when building it.

methods.name: buildSearchUrlQuery
methods.description: Builds URL query parameters for the search.

methods.name: usesAdminTheme
methods.description: Indicates if search results should be shown in the admin theme.
